items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 8 at 7:23PM AKDT until May 9 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Ketchikan Gateway Borough and Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 1 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will continue to increase through Friday
evening as a front moves through the area. Stronger wind gusts may
last longer into Saturday.
items.areas: Prince of Wales Island; Ketchikan Gateway Borough
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel by land, sea, or air difficult.

items.description:

on Thursday afternoon.  Several large ice runs from the ice jams
below Dawson have cleared Eagle and will be making their way past

expected with these ice runs, but no flooding.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 8 at 3:19PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
ESFAFC

CURRENT SITUATION:

As of Friday morning, an ice jam remains 15-20 miles downstream of
Aniak, near Birch Crossing. Water levels in Aniak rose Thursday
evening and overnight. Ice shifted at Kalskag, creating cracks and
pressure ridges. Flood products are currently in effect for both
Aniak and Kalskag.
